title: Add benchmark lab: representative workload runners, profiling baselines, and reporting pipeline v38
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Added new representative workload runners (mixed chat, streaming completions, batch embeddings), updated profiling baselines (cold-start + steady-state), and improved reporting pipeline with aggregated metrics and dashboards.
description:
Motivation: The benchmark lab needs more representative workload runners and updated profiling baselines to reflect our current serving optimizations (KV caching, batching heuristics, and quantization profiles). This PR adds three new runner types, updates profiling baselines for cold-start and steady-state scenarios, and upgrades the reporting pipeline to aggregate latency/cost percentiles and export them to the benchmark dataset for downstream dashboards and alerts.

Summary of changes (high level):
- Add representative runners: mixed-chat-runner (multi-turn chat with function/tool call simulations), streaming-completions-runner (streaming responses at varying partial-flush sizes), embedding-batch-runner (large-batch embedding workloads with sharded inputs).
- Add profiling baselines: cold_start_baselines.yaml, steady_state_baselines.yaml, and helper scripts for auto-sampling and warmup detection.
- Reporting pipeline improvements: new metrics aggregation stage, percentile calculations (p50/p90/p99) for latency and token-cost, and Kafka -> reporting DB ingestion job with backfill support.
- CI/workflow: add benchmark-lab workflow to run micro-benchmarks on PRs and nightly profiling job.
- Docs: update docs/benchmark-lab.md with runner configs and how to reproduce baselines locally.

Commits (summary):
1) feat(benchmark-lab): add mixed-chat representative runner and config templates
2) feat(benchmark-lab): add streaming-completions runner with partial-flush simulation
3) feat(benchmark-lab): add embedding-batch runner and sharding util
4) perf(profiling): add cold_start and steady_state baseline definitions + sampling script
5) infra(reporting): add aggregation stage + kafka ingestion job + backfill tool
6) ci: add benchmark-lab GitHub workflow and test harness

Changed files (high-level):
- benchmark-lab/runners/mixed_chat_runner.py
- benchmark-lab/runners/streaming_completions_runner.py
- benchmark-lab/runners/embedding_batch_runner.py
- benchmark-lab/profiling/cold_start_baselines.yaml
- benchmark-lab/profiling/steady_state_baselines.yaml
- benchmark-lab/profiling/sample_warmup.py
- benchmark-lab/reporting/aggregation.py
- benchmark-lab/reporting/kafka_ingest.py
- ci/workflows/benchmark-lab.yml
- docs/benchmark-lab.md
- tests/benchmark_lab/test_runners.py
- tests/benchmark_lab/test_aggregation.py

Testing and CI:
- Unit tests added for each runner and aggregation logic (tests/benchmark_lab/*).
- New GitHub Actions workflow triggers on PRs to main and nightly for full profiling.
- CI matrix includes small GPU runner (cpu simulation), integration against kafka-stub, and lint/format checks.
- The e2e-bench step was flaky on first run (timeboxed streaming test). After increasing timeout and reducing concurrency the job passed on rerun. All checks green at merge.

Review conversation (highlights):
- Ethan Kim: "Can we ensure the mixed-chat runner includes function-calling edge cases (tool failures, long outputs)?" -> Addressed by adding a 'tool_failure_ratio' config and new unit tests to simulate 5% failure.
- Lara Martinez: "Aggregation p99 is sensitive to outliers — did you add trimming/rolling window?" -> Added a rolling-window trimming parameter with default 30s and documented behavior.
- Noah Patel (SRE): "Kafka backfill needs idempotency guarantees; please add dedupe key." -> Added ingest dedupe using run_id+partition keys.
- Reviewer approval: after addressing comments, Ethan and Lara approved; SRE gave final thumbs-up.

Backward compatibility and safety:
- New runners and baselines are opt-in; existing benchmark jobs unchanged unless pipeline config updated.
- Reporting pipeline changes are additive; backfill runs are gated behind a feature flag.

Migration and rollout notes:
- Nightly profiling job will be enabled after merge; ops will run a 48-hour backfill on the reporting DB in a maintenance window.
- Docs updated with explicit reproduction steps and config defaults.

Merge: Squash-merged to main after all approvals and CI green.

Related linear/jira: ENG-12847 (benchmark lab runner expansion), ENG-13133 (profiling baseline refresh).

If you want to run locally: see docs/benchmark-lab.md -> quickstart and the ci/workflows/benchmark-lab.yml for the PR test matrix.
